title: Servex keeps crashing with no clue; one admin command lets the next crash name its cause

owner_note.text: Servex has crashed 6 times since 11-03 (latest 06:09Z today) in a way that leaves no error message. Running one command in an admin PowerShell (about 2 minutes, copy it from the task's first step) makes Windows save a crash file next time, and an agent then reads that file to find the cause.
